Feathers are among the most remarkable components in nature—
light, tough, flexible, and colorful. Feathers provide insulationand waterproofing. And, of course, they permit birds to fly.

complex society, humans have life-and-death control over thewaters. How we treat those waters and their resources determines the abundance of gamefish and the future of the sport.
